title: CodeLords Hub V0.01 (KEYLESS) versao portugues Br
script:
-- LocalScript - CodeLords Hub v0.01 com Intro, Áudio, Carregamento Extendido, Minimizar/Fechar e Prevenção de Duplicatas
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 0. PREVENÇÃO DE EXECUÇÃO DUPLICADA
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("UtilityHubGui")
if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. VARIÁVEIS DE ESTADO E SISTEMA
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local selectedTarget = nil
local isInvisibleActive = false
local invisiblePreviousCFrame = nil

local spectateConnection = nil
local isSpectating = false

local aimbotTargetConnection = nil
local isAimbotTargetActive = false

local aimbotNearestConnection = nil
local isAimbotNearestActive = false
local checkTeamFilter = false

local isMinimized = false

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. CRIAÇÃO DA INTERFACE VISUAL PRINCIPAL
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "UtilityHubGui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Container Principal (Oculto inicialmente para a Intro)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 520, 0, 420)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -260, 0.5, -210)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
MainFrame.Visible = false
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainUICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MainUICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
MainUICorner.Parent = MainFrame

local MainUIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
MainUIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0) -- Amarelo Gold
MainUIStroke.Thickness = 2
MainUIStroke.Parent = MainFrame

-- Top Bar / Cabeçalho
local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TopBar.Name = "TopBar"
TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
TopBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
TopBar.Parent = MainFrame

local TopBarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TopBarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
TopBarCorner.Parent = TopBar

local TitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, 0)
TitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
TitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleLabel.Text = "CodeLords Hub v0.01"
TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
TitleLabel.TextSize = 16
TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TitleLabel.Parent = TopBar

-- Botão Fechar (X)
local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseBtn.Name = "CloseBtn"
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -14)
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
CloseBtn.Text = "X"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseBtn.TextSize = 14
CloseBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
CloseBtn.Parent = TopBar

local CloseBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CloseBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
CloseBtnCorner.Parent = CloseBtn

-- Botão Minimizar (-)
local MinimizeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
MinimizeBtn.Name = "MinimizeBtn"
MinimizeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
MinimizeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0.5, -14)
MinimizeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
MinimizeBtn.Text = "-"
MinimizeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
MinimizeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
MinimizeBtn.TextSize = 16
MinimizeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
MinimizeBtn.Parent = TopBar

local MinimizeBtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MinimizeBtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
MinimizeBtnCorner.Parent = MinimizeBtn

-- Botão Flutuante de Abrir novamente ("Abrir CL Hub")
local OpenHubBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
OpenHubBtn.Name = "OpenHubBtn"
OpenHubBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 36)
OpenHubBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -18)
OpenHubBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18)
OpenHubBtn.Text = "Abrir CL Hub"
OpenHubBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
OpenHubBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
OpenHubBtn.TextSize = 13
OpenHubBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
OpenHubBtn.Active = true
OpenHubBtn.Draggable = true
OpenHubBtn.Visible = false
OpenHubBtn.Parent = ScreenGui

local OpenHubCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
OpenHubCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
OpenHubCorner.Parent = OpenHubBtn

local OpenHubStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
OpenHubStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
OpenHubStroke.Thickness = 1.5
OpenHubStroke.Parent = OpenHubBtn

-- Lógica de Minimizar
MinimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isMinimized = not isMinimized
	if isMinimized then
		TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 520, 0, 40)
		}):Play()
	else
		TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 520, 0, 420)
		}):Play()
	end
end)

-- Lógica de Fechar e Reabrir
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	MainFrame.Visible = false
	OpenHubBtn.Visible = true
end)

OpenHubBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	OpenHubBtn.Visible = false
	MainFrame.Visible = true
end)

-- Sidebar de Abas
local Sidebar = Instance.new("Frame")
Sidebar.Name = "Sidebar"
Sidebar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 1, -40)
Sidebar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 40)
Sidebar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 24)
Sidebar.BorderSizePixel = 0
Sidebar.Parent = MainFrame

local SidebarLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
SidebarLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
SidebarLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
SidebarLayout.Parent = Sidebar

local SidebarPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
SidebarPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
SidebarPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 5)
SidebarPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 5)
SidebarPadding.Parent = Sidebar

-- Áreas de Conteúdo
local ContentArea = Instance.new("Frame")
ContentArea.Name = "ContentArea"
ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -130, 1, -40)
ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 40)
ContentArea.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ContentArea.Parent = MainFrame

-- Tabela para guardar páginas
local Pages = {}

local function createPage(name)
	local Scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	Scroll.Name = name .. "Page"
	Scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	Scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	Scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
	Scroll.Visible = false
	Scroll.Parent = ContentArea

	local Layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	Layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	Layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
	Layout.Parent = Scroll

	local Padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	Padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
	Padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 15)
	Padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 15)
	Padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
	Padding.Parent = Scroll

	Pages[name] = Scroll
	return Scroll
end

-- Criação das Páginas
local CreditsPage = createPage("Créditos")
local ToolsPage = createPage("Tools")
local TargetPage = createPage("Target")

-- Troca de Abas
local function showPage(pageName)
	for name, page in pairs(Pages) do
		page.Visible = (name == pageName)
	end
end

local function createTabButton(text, pageName)
	local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	Btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
	Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
	Btn.Text = text
	Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
	Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
	Btn.TextSize = 14
	Btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Btn.Parent = Sidebar

	local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	Corner.Parent = Btn

	Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		for _, b in ipairs(Sidebar:GetChildren()) do
			if b:IsA("TextButton") then
				b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
				b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
			end
		end
		Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
		Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18)
		showPage(pageName)
	end)
	return Btn
end

-- Botões das Abas na Ordem Desejada
local tabCreditsBtn = createTabButton("Créditos", "Créditos")
local tabToolsBtn = createTabButton("Tools", "Tools")
local tabTargetBtn = createTabButton("Target", "Target")

-- Ativar a aba "Créditos" por padrão
tabCreditsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
tabCreditsBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18)
showPage("Créditos")

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. INTRO, ÁUDIO E TELA DE CARREGAMENTO EXTENDIDA
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Som da Intro
local IntroSound = Instance.new("Sound")
IntroSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9043887091" -- Música suave / chill ambient
IntroSound.Volume = 0.5
IntroSound.Looped = true
IntroSound.Parent = SoundService

local LoadingFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
LoadingFrame.Name = "LoadingFrame"
LoadingFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 220)
LoadingFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -190, 0.5, -110)
LoadingFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18)
LoadingFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
LoadingFrame.ZIndex = 50
LoadingFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local LoadingCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
LoadingCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
LoadingCorner.Parent = LoadingFrame

local LoadingStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
LoadingStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
LoadingStroke.Thickness = 2
LoadingStroke.Parent = LoadingFrame

local IntroTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
IntroTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
IntroTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35)
IntroTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
IntroTitle.Text = "CODELORDS HUB"
IntroTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
IntroTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
IntroTitle.TextSize = 22
IntroTitle.TextTransparency = 1
IntroTitle.Parent = LoadingFrame

local IntroSubTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
IntroSubTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
IntroSubTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 70)
IntroSubTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
IntroSubTitle.Text = "v0.01 — Inicializando Sistemas"
IntroSubTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
IntroSubTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
IntroSubTitle.TextSize = 13
IntroSubTitle.TextTransparency = 1
IntroSubTitle.Parent = LoadingFrame

-- Barra de Progresso Background
local ProgressBarBg = Instance.new("Frame")
ProgressBarBg.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 10)
ProgressBarBg.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.6, 0)
ProgressBarBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 32)
ProgressBarBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
ProgressBarBg.Parent = LoadingFrame

local ProgressBgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ProgressBgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
ProgressBgCorner.Parent = ProgressBarBg

-- Barra de Progresso Fill
local ProgressBarFill = Instance.new("Frame")
ProgressBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
ProgressBarFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
ProgressBarFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
ProgressBarFill.Parent = ProgressBarBg

local ProgressFillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ProgressFillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
ProgressFillCorner.Parent = ProgressBarFill

local StatusText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
StatusText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
StatusText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.72, 0)
StatusText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
StatusText.Text = "Iniciando CodeLords Engine... 0%"
StatusText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
StatusText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
StatusText.TextSize = 11
StatusText.Parent = LoadingFrame

-- Animação da Intro
task.spawn(function()
	IntroSound:Play()

	-- Fade In Títulos
	TweenService:Create(IntroTitle, TweenInfo.new(1), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	task.wait(0.4)
	TweenService:Create(IntroSubTitle, TweenInfo.new(1), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	task.wait(0.6)

	-- Animação de Carregamento Longa (6 Segundos)
	local duration = 6.0
	local startTime = tick()

	while tick() - startTime < duration do
		local alpha = (tick() - startTime) / duration
		ProgressBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(alpha, 0, 1, 0)

		local percent = math.floor(alpha * 100)
		if percent < 25 then
			StatusText.Text = "Carregando Módulos... " .. percent .. "%"
		elseif percent < 50 then
			StatusText.Text = "Verificando Permissões e Segurança... " .. percent .. "%"
		elseif percent < 80 then
			StatusText.Text = "Sincronizando Ferramentas & Target... " .. percent .. "%"
		else
			StatusText.Text = "Finalizando Configurações... " .. percent .. "%"
		end

		RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
	end

	ProgressBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	StatusText.Text = "Pronto! 100%"
	task.wait(0.6)

	-- Fade Out da Música e da Interface
	TweenService:Create(IntroSound, TweenInfo.new(0.8), {Volume = 0}):Play()

	local fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(LoadingFrame, fadeInfo, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 240), BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(LoadingStroke, fadeInfo, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(IntroTitle, fadeInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(IntroSubTitle, fadeInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(StatusText, fadeInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(ProgressBarBg, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(ProgressBarFill, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()

	task.wait(0.8)
	IntroSound:Stop()
	IntroSound:Destroy()
	LoadingFrame:Destroy()

	-- Exibe o Hub Principal
	MainFrame.Visible = true
	MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 400)
	TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 520, 0, 420)
	}):Play()
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. UTILS E ELEMENTOS VISUAIS DA GUI
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function addSectionTitle(parent, text)
	local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
	Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Label.Text = string.upper(text)
	Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
	Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	Label.TextSize = 13
	Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	Label.Parent = parent
	return Label
end

local function createActionButton(parent, text)
	local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	Btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
	Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 32)
	Btn.Text = text
	Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
	Btn.TextSize = 13
	Btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Btn.Parent = parent

	local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	Corner.Parent = Btn

	local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	Stroke.Thickness = 1
	Stroke.Parent = Btn

	Btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
	end)
	Btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 32)
	end)

	return Btn
end

local function createToggle(parent, text, callback)
	local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	Frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
	Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28)
	Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	Frame.Parent = parent

	local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	Corner.Parent = Frame

	local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	Label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
	Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
	Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Label.Text = text
	Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
	Label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	Label.TextSize = 13
	Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	Label.Parent = Frame

	local Switch = Instance.new("TextButton")
	Switch.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 22)
	Switch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0.5, -11)
	Switch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
	Switch.Text = ""
	Switch.Parent = Frame

	local SwitchCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	SwitchCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	SwitchCorner.Parent = Switch

	local Knob = Instance.new("Frame")
	Knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
	Knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -9)
	Knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	Knob.Parent = Switch

	local KnobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	KnobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	KnobCorner.Parent = Knob

	local state = false
	Switch.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		state = not state
		if state then
			Switch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
			Knob.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0.5, -9)
			Knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18)
		else
			Switch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
			Knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -9)
			Knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
		end
		callback(state)
	end)

	return Frame
end

local function showNotificationModal(message, onYes, onNo)
	local ModalOverlay = Instance.new("Frame")
	ModalOverlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	ModalOverlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	ModalOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
	ModalOverlay.ZIndex = 100
	ModalOverlay.Parent = ScreenGui

	local ModalFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	ModalFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 160)
	ModalFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -80)
	ModalFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 24)
	ModalFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	ModalFrame.Parent = ModalOverlay

	local MCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	MCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	MCorner.Parent = ModalFrame

	local MStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	MStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
	MStroke.Thickness = 1.5
	MStroke.Parent = ModalFrame

	local MsgLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	MsgLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 80)
	MsgLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
	MsgLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	MsgLabel.Text = message
	MsgLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
	MsgLabel.TextWrapped = true
	MsgLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	MsgLabel.TextSize = 13
	MsgLabel.Parent = ModalFrame

	local YesBtn = createActionButton(ModalFrame, "Sim")
	YesBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 32)
	YesBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 30, 1, -45)
	YesBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
	YesBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18)

	local NoBtn = createActionButton(ModalFrame, "Não")
	NoBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 32)
	NoBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, -45)

	YesBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ModalOverlay:Destroy()
		if onYes then onYes() end
	end)

	NoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		ModalOverlay:Destroy()
		if onNo then onNo() end
	end)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. CONTEÚDO DA ABA: CRÉDITOS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local mainCreditsLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
mainCreditsLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
mainCreditsLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
mainCreditsLabel.Text = "GUI feita por CodeLords Group, com ajuda de Gemini"
mainCreditsLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
mainCreditsLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
mainCreditsLabel.TextSize = 13
mainCreditsLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
mainCreditsLabel.Parent = CreditsPage

local collabLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
collabLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
collabLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
collabLabel.Text = "Colaboradores: @Gerlsao_CodeLords, @Dudaduda_23"
collabLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
collabLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
collabLabel.TextSize = 12
collabLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
collabLabel.Parent = CreditsPage

local funLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
funLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60)
funLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
funLabel.Text = "Divirta-se ;)"
funLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 204, 0)
funLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
funLabel.TextSize = 28
funLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
funLabel.Parent = CreditsPage

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. CONTEÚDO DA ABA: TOOLS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
addSectionTitle(ToolsPage, "Tools de utilidade")

local btnInvisible = createActionButton(ToolsPage, "Tool Invisível")
btnInvisible.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack and not backpack:FindFirstChild("Invisível") and not (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Invisível")) then
		local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
		tool.Name = "Invisível"
		tool.RequiresHandle = false
		tool.CanBeDropped = false
		tool.Parent = backpack

		tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

			local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
			invisiblePreviousCFrame = hrp.CFrame
			isInvisibleActive = true

			hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, 99999, hrp.Position.Z)
			hrp.Anchored = true

			for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") then
					part.Transparency = 0.5
				end
			end

			Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable

			task.spawn(function()
				while isInvisibleActive and char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") do
					Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(invisiblePreviousCFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 10), invisiblePreviousCFrame.Position)
					RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
				end
			end)
		end)

		tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
			isInvisibleActive = false
			local char = LocalPlayer.Character
			if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
				hrp.Anchored = false
				if invisiblePreviousCFrame then
					hrp.CFrame = invisiblePreviousCFrame
				end

				for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then
						if part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
							part.Transparency = 1
						else
							part.Transparency = 0
						end
					elseif part:IsA("Decal") then
						part.Transparency = 0
					end
				end
			end

			Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
			if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
				Camera.CameraSubject = char.Humanoid
			end
		end)
	end
end)

addSectionTitle(TargetPage, "Funções")

local function executeFling()
	if not selectedTarget or not selectedTarget.Character or not selectedTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		return
	end

	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

	local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
	local targetHrp = selectedTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart

	local oldCFrame = hrp.CFrame
	local startTime = tick()

	local BodyAngularVelocity = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
	BodyAngularVelocity.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)
	BodyAngularVelocity.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	BodyAngularVelocity.P = 125000
	BodyAngularVelocity.Parent = hrp

	local renderConn
	renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if tick() - startTime < 2 and selectedTarget and selectedTarget.Character and selectedTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			hrp.CFrame = targetHrp.CFrame
		else
			renderConn:Disconnect()
			BodyAngularVelocity:Destroy()
			hrp.CFrame = oldCFrame
		end
	end)
end

local btnFling = createActionButton(TargetPage, "Arremesso")
btnFling.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if not selectedTarget then return end

	local targetChar = selectedTarget.Character
	if not targetChar then return end

	local hum = targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hrp = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local isSeated = hum and hum.Sit
	local hasNoCollision = false
	if hrp and not hrp.CanCollide then
		hasNoCollision = true
	end

	if isSeated or hasNoCollision then
		showNotificationModal("O alvo não tem colisão ou está sentado, deseja executar o arremesso mesmo assim?", function()
			executeFling()
		end)
	else
		executeFling()
	end
end)

local function getNearestPlayer()
	local closestPlayer = nil
	local shortestDistance = math.huge

	local localChar = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not localChar or not localChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end

	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			if checkTeamFilter and p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
				continue
			end

			local dist = (p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - localChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			if dist < shortestDistance then
				shortestDistance = dist
				closestPlayer = p
			end
		end
	end
	return closestPlayer
end

			local nearest = getNearestPlayer()
			if nearest and nearest.Character and nearest.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				local targetPos = nearest.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
				Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPos)
			end
		end)
	else
		if aimbotNearestConnection then aimbotNearestConnection:Disconnect() end
	end
end)
